title: SCA Minhag of the Week 283: "Wearing a Talet Qatan”

chapters.title: Obligation and the Rambam
chapters.about: Four-cornered garments and Rambam's view on the mitzvah

chapters.title: Shulchan Aruch and the talit cotan
chapters.about: Maran's recommendation to wear a talit cotan all day

chapters.title: Customs of the rabbis of Halab
chapters.about: 19th and 20th-century discussions on blessings and customs

chapters.title: Placement and loop counts
chapters.about: Wearing garments under clothing and the number of loops

summary: The teacher discusses the practice of wearing a talit cotan, tracing the concept from the Rambam and the Shulchan Aruch to the customs of the rabbis of Halab. He reviews various traditions regarding the recitation of blessings, the placement of the garment, and the number of loops used for the tzitziot.
questions: Is one obligated to wear a four-cornered garment?
What does the Shulchan Aruch say about wearing a talit cotan all day?
How do we fulfill the blessing requirement for the talit cotan?
What is the difference between the 39-loop and 26-loop customs?
Should the talit cotan be worn over or under one's clothing?
